judgments.reason: Candidate is the PhysioNet bigP3BCI record with the same title and authors; nm000351 is a BIDS-converted Study P subset of it (DOI 10.13026/0byy-ry86).
judgments.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool paper for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; a tool used for curation, not a paper describing the bigP3BCI data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension for organizing EEG data, which this BIDS-formatted dataset uses; it does not describe the bigP3BCI Study P data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
